questions.explanation: TLS stands for Transport Layer Security, the successor to SSL.

questions.prompt: What major performance improvement does TLS 1.3 offer over TLS 1.2 during a new handshake?
questions.explanation: TLS 1.3 reduces the handshake from 2 round trips to 1 round trip.

questions.prompt: Why was the RSA Key Exchange deprecated in TLS 1.3?
questions.explanation: Static RSA key exchange does not provide Perfect Forward Secrecy.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the Client Random and Server Random?
options: To prevent replay attacks and ensure unique session keys
questions.explanation: Randoms ensure freshness and prevent replay attacks.

questions.prompt: In the TLS handshake, what is the role of the ChangeCipherSpec message?
options: To signal that subsequent records will be encrypted
questions.explanation: It tells the other party that all future messages will be encrypted with the negotiated keys.
